entries.code_description: CHAPTER 49 - PRINTED BOOKS, NEWSPAPERS, PICTURES AND OTHER PRODUCTS OF THE PRINTING INDUSTRY; MANUSCRIPTS, TYPESCRIPTS AND PLANS
entries.comment:
Magazines and other periodicals in the form of printed publication or electronic publication, website publications and subscription fees, including the supply of the abovementioned periodicals online or by downloading them, if they are published in Latvian, Latgalian, or Livonian, as well as in the official languages of the EU, the EEA, Switzerland, EU candidate countries, and the OECD.
(Section 42, Paragraphs 7–9 of the Law; https://likumi.lv/ta/en/en/id/253451)

entries.category_description: Supply, including on loan by libraries, of books, newspapers and periodicals either on physical means of support or supplied electronically or both (including brochures, leaflets and similar printed matter, children's picture, drawing or colouring books, music printed or in manuscript form, maps and hydrographic or similar charts), other than publications wholly or predominantly devoted to advertising and other than publications wholly or predominantly consisting of video content or audible music.

(Section 42, Paragraphs 5, 8, and 9 of the Law; https://likumi.lv/ta/en/en/id/253451)

entries.comment: Tabel I prov. a.31 and b.1: certain braille products; clocks, optical reading devices, TV magnifiers, reading platforms, orientation aids, support, tactile and recognition canes designed for personal use of blind and partially sighted persons; guide dogs; other aids designated by ministerial regulation that have been specially designed for exclusive and personal use by blind and partially sighted persons; reading pens and other equipment with similar function, equipment for use by dyslexics.
